mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1600 (thousand units), indicating a housing market boom, consumer wealth effects boost spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.
